stem.text: Boiling the bones and teeth from dead animals can be used to produce a type of glue.
The glue is formed from the collagen fibres present in bones and teeth.
Which statement describes the changes to collagen that occur when the glue is produced?

A.text: The fibres of collagen become more coiled.

B.text: The fibres of collagen become more flexible.

C.text: The helices of collagen molecules unwind.

D.text: The molecules of collagen dissolve in water.
